notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Hello. I've watched some replays on the leaderboards and noticed some pain points. So I fixed them.

Features:

 Added a tip when there are only draggers left and you have a laser. Most people don't read all of the tips (or any) so they don't know they can charge the laser.
 Added tips before each game to get them in front of players. They really are necessary.


Bug Fixes:

 Moved gui elements on top of the game. Sometimes it would be impossible to see the score.


Again, please leave comments and suggestions. Good and bad because both will help make this game better and thus your experience :)
